The main takeaway from our work is that
study designs that are optimal for estimating the secondary attack rate are not optimal for studies comparing secondary infection rates between different groups.
the design of household influenza transmission studies should be tailored to the study objectives, and that reactive home visits are an important tool in the study of influenza transmission.
